title: Delete asks first with the PRD's words and no counts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with a part in the inventory.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The menu lists Delete.

Step 4:

  • A question titled "Delete", category A's name and "?" opens.
  • It reads "Its parts and lines, invoiced ones included, move to Uncategorized, and its QuickBooks mapping is removed. Invoices already sent aren't sent again; one synced again later books these parts to Uncategorized's QuickBooks item. This can't be undone."
  • The buttons are Cancel and a red Delete.
  • No count of parts or lines is shown.

Step 5:

  • The question closes.
  • Category A's page still shows.
